notes.title: No update in December
notes.notes:
I have not finished the next update : "custom AI".

With the approach of Christmas, I lack of time and I will not publish an unfinished update that could bring new bugs.

Sorry and thank you for your understanding. I'm working alone on Aurora Dusk.


Happy holidays to you and your families!
